name: weekly_one_on_one
description: Weekly 1:1 between a manager and direct report to review work, surface blockers early, check well-being, and maintain momentum on growth and priorities.

sections.label: Current Focus and Progress
sections.description: Capture the top active work since the last 1:1—what moved, outcomes, what's still in progress, and notable learnings—briefly, not a full status report.

sections.label: Upcoming Priorities and Plans
sections.description: Record the few most important tasks until the next 1:1, why they matter, expected effort, and planned milestones.

sections.label: Risks and Blockers
sections.description: Describe any concrete risks or blockers with brief context, suspected root cause, user or business impact, and risk level; any resulting asks or owners should be captured in support_requests_and_commitments.

sections.label: Support Requests and Commitments
sections.description: Review status of open commitments from prior 1:1s and mark each done/blocked/rolled, then capture new or updated requests and commitments with a clear owner, specific next step, and due date; unresolved items should either spawn a risks_and_blockers entry or be re-committed.

sections.label: Feedback, Coaching, and Decisions
sections.description: Capture bidirectional feedback and coaching (report ↔ manager), questions about approach or quality bar, and any decisions that adjust scope, priority, or standards; log decisions and brief rationale here, while any resulting action items/owners/dates go in support_requests_and_commitments.

sections.label: Check-in and Report-led Topics
sections.description: Note how the report is feeling, workload sustainability, morale or team dynamics, and any report-led agenda items or questions they want to discuss that do not fit elsewhere.

sections.label: Recognition and Wins
sections.description: Call out notable achievements, shipped outcomes, or positive behaviors to reinforce.

sections.label: Career Growth and Development
sections.description: Document growth topics such as skills to build, role aspirations, stretch opportunities, learning plans, and check-ins on development goals.

sections.label: Other
sections.description: Anything material that doesn't fit a declared section. Prefer declared sections; use this only when nothing else fits.

phases.label: Rapport and Check-in
phases.goal: Build rapport and understand how the report is doing personally and professionally to set context for the rest of the meeting.

phases.label: Work Review and Blockers
phases.goal: Get crisp visibility into current work, review prior commitments, and surface risks early.

phases.label: Planning and Alignment
phases.goal: Align on next-week priorities, capture requests, and provide guidance to ensure momentum.

phases.label: Growth and Wrap
phases.goal: Spend time on development if topics are queued; otherwise, reallocate this time to work review/planning, then confirm owners, dates, and takeaways before closing.
